skills.title: Explain example status
skills.description: Read the local demonstration status and explain its task record.
skills.instructions: When the user requests this example status, call the listed status service using plugin.call-service with version 1 and an empty input object. Wait for its task result, then explain the log and terminal state. This is a local demonstration, not a live external status source. If the service is unavailable or approval is denied, report that outcome; do not infer a successful status.
